name: Chicago Tribune editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Chicago Tribune Center (online news; low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found.

name: Chicago Sun-Times editorial board
lean_basis: Owned since 2022 by nonprofit Chicago Public Media (WBEZ's parent), a 501(c)(3), so it does not endorse candidates; it publishes voter guides and candidate questionnaires instead. AllSides rates its news Lean Left (medium confidence, Oct. 2026).

name: Crain's Chicago Business editorial board
lean_basis: Business weekly that calls itself 'the top source of news and information on all things business in the Chicago area' (https://www.chicagobusiness.com/corporate/ccb-about-us/). No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.

name: League of Women Voters of Illinois (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that calls itself 'a nonpartisan organization that works to protect fair elections and increase civic engagement' (https://lwvil.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Injustice Watch: Check Your Judges
lean_basis: Nonprofit newsroom that calls itself 'the only newsroom in Cook County dedicated to reporting on the court system' (https://www.injusticewatch.org/) and makes no endorsements. No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.

name: Democratic Party of Illinois
lean_basis: Official state party organization (chair: Lisa Hernandez). Backs its primary winners in the general election. The Cook County Democratic Party separately slated Pritzker/Mitchell, Raoul, Giannoulias, Frerichs and Croke in July 2025 and made no Senate primary endorsement.

name: Illinois Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization (chair: Kathy Salvi; Don Tracy chaired it 2021 to 2024). Backs its primary winners in the general election.

name: Illinois AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation of 'more than 1,500 affiliated unions' (https://ilafl-cio.org/); unions map to lean_left (workers' bargaining power and labor rights). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Chicago Federation of Labor
lean_basis: Central labor council for Chicago and Cook County that says it 'fights to support workers in Chicago, Cook County, and beyond' (https://chicagolabor.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Illinois Federation of Teachers (incl. Chicago Teachers Union, Local 1)
lean_basis: Statewide teachers' union (AFT affiliate, includes the Chicago Teachers Union) whose stated vision is 'Members fighting powerfully for a strong union and the future we all deserve' (https://www.ift-aft.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Personal PAC (abortion rights)
lean_basis: Abortion-rights PAC that says it is 'dedicated to protecting and advancing reproductive rights' (https://personalpac.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Illinois Federation for Right to Life PAC
lean_basis: Anti-abortion group that says 'human life should be protected by law from womb to tomb without exceptions' (https://www.illinoisrighttolife.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Illinois Manufacturers' Association (IMA PAC)
lean_basis: Manufacturing trade group that calls itself 'the unifying voice and champion of manufacturing in Illinois' (https://ima-net.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund (Illinois grades)
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the National Rifle Association, which calls itself 'a single issue organization' that grades candidates on 'Second Amendment issues' (https://www.nrapvf.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Illinois Fraternal Order of Police (State Lodge)
lean_basis: Police union whose own description, that it is 'committed to improving the working conditions of law enforcement officers and the safety of those we serve' (https://www.ilfop.org/about), uses no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Sierra Club Illinois Chapter
lean_basis: AllSides rates the national Sierra Club Lean Left (think tank/policy group; independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). This is its Illinois chapter.
